text: Those cities, more especially, which have been used to freedom or to be governed by their own citizens, rest far better satisfied with a government which they do not see, even though it involve something of oppression, than with one which standing constantly before their eyes, seems every day to reproach them with the disgrace of servitude.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
